qualification.details: Medical Superintendent: Medical qualification as per IMC Act + PG degree/MHA + 10 years hospital administration experience. Chief Librarian: Master's in Science + Library Science degree/diploma + analogous post or 5 years in GP 7600/6600. Registrar: Graduate + 7 years administrative/supervisory experience. Senior Analyst (System Analyst): Analogous post or GP 6600 with 5 years service. Chief Nursing Officer: Analogous post or 5/10 years in PB-3 GP 6600/5400. Senior Administrative Officer: Analogous post or 5 years in GP 5400. Senior Procurement Cum Store Officer: Analogous post or 5 years in GP 5400 + 5 years Stores Officer experience. Nursing Superintendent: Analogous post or 5 years Deputy/Assistant Nursing Superintendent in GP 5400. Chief Dietician: Analogous post or 5/7 years in GP 5400/4600 as Senior Dietician/Dietician. Chief Medical Social Service Officer: Analogous post or 5 years in GP 5400 + MSW + 5 years Medical Social Welfare experience. CSSD Officer: Analogous post or 5/7 years CSSD Supervisor in GP 5400/4600. Principle Private Secretary: Analogous post or 7 years in GP 4600 or higher. Librarian Selection Grade (Senior Librarian): Analogous post or 5/6/7 years in GP 5400/4800/4600. Chief Medical Record Officer: Analogous post or 2/3 years in GP 4800/4600 + Degree in Medical Record Keeping + computer typing speed. Private Secretary: Analogous post or 5 years in GP 4200 or higher. Chief Pharmacist: Analogous post or 5 years Pharmacist Grade II in GP 4200. Senior Sanitation Officer: Analogous post or 5 years in GP 4200 in 200 bedded hospital. Manager/ Supervisor/ Gas Officer: Analogous post or 11 years experience in GP 2800. Junior Administrative Officer: Analogous post or 10 years in GP 2400 + Degree + computer proficiency. Sr. Pharmacist: Analogous post or 6 years Pharmacist Grade II in GP 2800. Pharmacist Grade I: Analogous post or 6 years Pharmacist Grade II in GP 2800. Medical Record Officer: Analogous post or 6 years Junior Medical Record Officer in GP 2800. Sanitation Officer: Analogous post or 6 years in GP 2800 in 200 bedded hospital. Personal Assistant: Analogous post or 10 years in GP 2400. Senior Administrative Assistant (UDC): Analogous post or 8 years in GP 1900 + Degree + computer proficiency.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Group A, B and C Posts is 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 61 vacancies for Various Group A, B and C Posts announced by AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates will range from Level 4 to Level 14 as per the 7th CPC, along with NPA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Deputation.

faq.question: Q7. Where is AIIMS Bhubaneswar located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhubaneswar is located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, with the pincode 751019.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, Cadre Clearance, and Vigilance Clearance.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Bhubaneswar: https://aiimsbhubaneswar.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: The qualification varies for each post and is detailed in the official notification. Generally, it requires specific degrees and experience relevant to the post.
